mission: Increase real capability, reasoning quality, reliability, verification and maintainability rather than bot count.

blueprints.name: Causal Failure Graph
blueprints.goal: Infer probable cause chains instead of treating every failed check independently.

blueprints.name: Root Cause Confidence Model
blueprints.goal: Assign calibrated probability to competing root-cause hypotheses.

blueprints.name: Symptom Versus Cause Classifier
blueprints.goal: Separate downstream symptoms from the actual originating fault.

blueprints.name: Temporal Correlation Engine
blueprints.goal: Compare event timing across commits workflows deployments and health failures.

blueprints.name: Change-to-Failure Correlator
blueprints.goal: Connect changed files dependencies and workflow edits with later failures.

blueprints.name: Causal Counterexample Search
blueprints.goal: Search for evidence that would disprove the current root-cause theory.

blueprints.name: Minimal Reproduction Builder
blueprints.goal: Reduce complex incidents to the smallest reproducible failing case.

blueprints.name: Cause Recurrence Predictor
blueprints.goal: Estimate which known failure patterns are likely to reappear.

blueprints.name: Failure Cascade Breakpoint Finder
blueprints.goal: Identify the earliest point where a failure cascade can be stopped safely.

blueprints.name: Causal Postmortem Generator
blueprints.goal: Generate evidence-backed postmortems linking trigger cause propagation recovery and prevention.

blueprints.name: Repository Digital Twin
blueprints.goal: Build a read-only structural model of repositories workflows dependencies and services.

blueprints.name: Workflow Dry Run Simulator
blueprints.goal: Predict workflow effects before committing changes.

blueprints.name: Deployment Scenario Simulator
blueprints.goal: Model deployment states including DNS Pages TLS redirects and rollback.

blueprints.name: Failure Injection Simulator
blueprints.goal: Safely simulate selected failures without touching production.

blueprints.name: Provider Outage Simulation
blueprints.goal: Test council behavior when TGPT or another optional provider becomes unavailable.

blueprints.name: Network Loss Simulation
blueprints.goal: Test behavior when Termux temporarily loses connectivity.

blueprints.name: GitHub API Rate Limit Simulator
blueprints.goal: Validate degraded operation when GitHub API quota is constrained.

blueprints.name: Scheduler Failure Simulator
blueprints.goal: Model missed cron or Actions runs and recovery behavior.

blueprints.name: State Corruption Simulation
blueprints.goal: Inject controlled invalid state into temporary copies to validate recovery logic.

blueprints.name: Recovery Time Benchmark
blueprints.goal: Measure time required to return from simulated failure to known-good state.

blueprints.name: Semantic Repository Map
blueprints.goal: Build a graph of modules services scripts workflows tests and ownership.

blueprints.name: Function Dependency Graph
blueprints.goal: Track which functions call and depend on other functions.

blueprints.name: Configuration Dependency Graph
blueprints.goal: Map environment configuration workflow config and runtime config relationships.

blueprints.name: Dead Code Candidate Detector
blueprints.goal: Identify apparently unused code for review without deleting automatically.

blueprints.name: Duplicate Logic Detector
blueprints.goal: Find functionally similar implementation patterns across Mikis13 repos.

blueprints.name: API Contract Map
blueprints.goal: Document request response and compatibility contracts between components.

blueprints.name: Breaking Change Detector
blueprints.goal: Detect interface changes likely to break dependent components.

blueprints.name: Architecture Drift Detector
blueprints.goal: Compare current implementation with declared architectural responsibilities.

blueprints.name: Complexity Hotspot Analyzer
blueprints.goal: Find code regions where complexity and failure frequency combine.

blueprints.name: Refactor Value Estimator
blueprints.goal: Estimate whether a refactor is likely to reduce defects or only rearrange code.

blueprints.name: Property Based Test Generator
blueprints.goal: Generate invariant-based tests for suitable pure logic.

blueprints.name: Mutation Testing Planner
blueprints.goal: Check whether tests really detect deliberately introduced small faults.

blueprints.name: Regression Test Memory
blueprints.goal: Store a regression test requirement for every confirmed recurring failure.

blueprints.name: Test Gap Detector
blueprints.goal: Find changed high-risk surfaces lacking direct test coverage.

blueprints.name: Flaky Test Classifier
blueprints.goal: Distinguish deterministic failures from flaky tests using historical runs.

blueprints.name: Test Duration Optimizer
blueprints.goal: Order fast high-value tests before slower suites.

blueprints.name: Risk Weighted Test Selection
blueprints.goal: Select test depth from code surface risk and failure history.

blueprints.name: Contract Test Generator
blueprints.goal: Generate tests for APIs configuration schemas and worker response contracts.

blueprints.name: Negative Path Test Planner
blueprints.goal: Systematically test invalid missing delayed and malformed inputs.

blueprints.name: Test Effectiveness Score
blueprints.goal: Measure which tests historically prevented regressions or caught real defects.

blueprints.name: Prompt Compiler
blueprints.goal: Build role prompts from modular policy evidence and output contracts.

blueprints.name: Prompt Linter
blueprints.goal: Detect contradictions missing gates ambiguity and redundant instructions.

blueprints.name: Prompt Diff Reviewer
blueprints.goal: Explain behavioral implications of each master-prompt change.

blueprints.name: Prompt Benchmark Harness
blueprints.goal: Evaluate old and new prompts against fixed representative cases.

blueprints.name: Prompt Regression Gate
blueprints.goal: Reject prompt changes that degrade safety evidence quality or task completion.

blueprints.name: Role Context Pack Builder
blueprints.goal: Give each specialist only the evidence relevant to its responsibility.

blueprints.name: Uncertainty Budget
blueprints.goal: Force explicit accounting of unresolved uncertainty before action.

blueprints.name: Prompt Stop Condition Generator
blueprints.goal: Require explicit conditions for stopping reasoning research or implementation.

blueprints.name: Tool Selection Prompt Policy
blueprints.goal: Teach workers when to use GitHub local analysis TGPT or no tool at all.

blueprints.name: Anti-Hallucination Evidence Gate
blueprints.goal: Reject specific factual claims lacking identifiable evidence.

blueprints.name: Knowledge Confidence Decay
blueprints.goal: Reduce confidence in knowledge that has not been revalidated recently.

blueprints.name: Knowledge Provenance Graph
blueprints.goal: Attach each learned fact to its source run file PR test or observation.

blueprints.name: Contradictory Memory Resolver
blueprints.goal: Detect conflicting historical conclusions and require revalidation.

blueprints.name: Knowledge Compression Engine
blueprints.goal: Convert repetitive operational logs into concise reusable lessons.

blueprints.name: Knowledge Retention Policy
blueprints.goal: Keep durable lessons while aging out low-value transient detail.

blueprints.name: Failure Signature Canonicalizer
blueprints.goal: Normalize different log text that represents the same underlying failure.

blueprints.name: Successful Fix Retrieval
blueprints.goal: Find historically successful fixes for similar evidence patterns.

blueprints.name: Knowledge Gap Register
blueprints.goal: Maintain explicit list of unknowns preventing strong decisions.

blueprints.name: Assumption Register
blueprints.goal: Track assumptions separately from confirmed facts.

blueprints.name: Decision Provenance Ledger
blueprints.goal: Record exactly which evidence produced each important decision.

blueprints.name: SBOM Generator
blueprints.goal: Generate software bill of materials for relevant buildable projects.

blueprints.name: License Compliance Gate
blueprints.goal: Detect license metadata problems before release workflows.

blueprints.name: Dependency Provenance Checker
blueprints.goal: Record source and version provenance of dependencies.

blueprints.name: Dependency Pinning Advisor
blueprints.goal: Recommend where exact versions improve reproducibility.

blueprints.name: Reproducible Build Monitor
blueprints.goal: Compare repeated clean builds for consistent artifacts.

blueprints.name: Artifact Manifest Generator
blueprints.goal: Record artifact hashes versions source commit and build metadata.

blueprints.name: Artifact Integrity Verifier
blueprints.goal: Verify generated artifact hash against recorded manifest.

blueprints.name: Release Readiness Score
blueprints.goal: Combine build test security documentation and rollback readiness.

blueprints.name: Release Candidate Isolation
blueprints.goal: Keep release candidates isolated until all required gates pass.

blueprints.name: Release Evidence Bundle
blueprints.goal: Bundle test security provenance and healthcheck evidence for release review.

blueprints.name: Android Doze Awareness
blueprints.goal: Detect likely background suspension and avoid assuming local scheduler reliability.

blueprints.name: Battery Aware Scheduler
blueprints.goal: Delay noncritical heavy local jobs when battery conditions are poor.

blueprints.name: Charging Window Worker
blueprints.goal: Prefer heavier maintenance tasks while device is charging where available.

blueprints.name: Thermal Load Guard
blueprints.goal: Avoid excessive concurrent computation under sustained device load.

blueprints.name: Storage Pressure Guard
blueprints.goal: Monitor logs caches worktrees and reports before storage exhaustion.

blueprints.name: Log Rotation V2
blueprints.goal: Compress or expire old operational logs according to retention policy.

blueprints.name: Network Quality Awareness
blueprints.goal: Differentiate offline degraded unstable and healthy network states.

blueprints.name: Termux Environment Doctor
blueprints.goal: Verify packages PATH permissions TMPDIR git gh python and scheduler requirements.

blueprints.name: Mirror Failure Recovery
blueprints.goal: Detect invalid Termux package mirror configuration and recommend known-good source.

blueprints.name: Local Disk State Backup
blueprints.goal: Maintain bounded local backup of critical non-secret operational state.

blueprints.name: Service Level Objective Registry
blueprints.goal: Define measurable reliability objectives for important Mikis13 services.

blueprints.name: Error Budget Tracker
blueprints.goal: Measure how much acceptable failure budget remains before feature work pauses.

blueprints.name: Incident Severity Classifier
blueprints.goal: Classify incidents from informational to critical using impact evidence.

blueprints.name: Incident Commander Role
blueprints.goal: Temporarily change council priority from development to recovery during incidents.

blueprints.name: Incident Timeline Builder
blueprints.goal: Build precise event timeline from commits workflows checks and recovery actions.

blueprints.name: Recovery Verification Gate
blueprints.goal: Require proof that the original failure is gone after a repair.

blueprints.name: Recurrence Prevention Gate
blueprints.goal: Require regression prevention for confirmed recurring incidents.

blueprints.name: Silent Failure Detector
blueprints.goal: Find components that stopped producing expected heartbeat or outputs without explicit errors.

blueprints.name: Partial Failure Detector
blueprints.goal: Detect situations where some services are healthy while dependent functionality is broken.

blueprints.name: Operational Readiness Review
blueprints.goal: Evaluate whether a prototype is ready for sustained unattended operation.

blueprints.name: Unknown Unknown Hunter
blueprints.goal: Search specifically for blind spots not represented by existing blueprints.

blueprints.name: Automation Cannibalization Detector
blueprints.goal: Detect when two automations compete modify the same state or reduce each other's value.

blueprints.name: Capability Gap Map
blueprints.goal: Map desired system capabilities against currently proven capabilities.

blueprints.name: Complexity Inflation Alarm
blueprints.goal: Detect when system complexity grows faster than measurable capability.

blueprints.name: Intelligence Theater Detector
blueprints.goal: Flag bots councils or scores that appear intelligent but add no measurable decision quality.

blueprints.name: Automation Half Life Score
blueprints.goal: Estimate how quickly an automation may become obsolete or maintenance-heavy.

blueprints.name: Reversible Experiment Framework
blueprints.goal: Prefer experiments whose effects can be cleanly undone.

blueprints.name: Novelty Versus Utility Judge
blueprints.goal: Separate genuinely useful innovation from novelty that lacks user value.

blueprints.name: Capability Retirement Engine
blueprints.goal: Recommend retiring obsolete capabilities only after dependency and evidence review.

blueprints.name: Mikis13 Constitutional Review
blueprints.goal: Periodically test whether architecture prompts permissions learning and automation still serve the core mission.
